question: What is the status of the event which bought "Post Cards, Posters" on 2019/8/20?
predicted_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.status FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T3.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' AND T3.expense_date LIKE '2019-08-20%'

question: Among the patients who were diagnosed with SLE, who is the oldest with normal hemoglobin level. Provide the ID and sex.
predicted_sql: SELECT P.ID, P.SEX FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.Birthday IS NOT NULL AND (P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS E WHERE E.ID = P.ID AND E.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.ID = P.ID AND L.HGB > 10 AND L.HGB < 17) ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC, P.ID ASC LIMIT 1
gold_sql: SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB > 10 AND T2.HGB < 17 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
